issues.quote: /wholesale/ has “noindex, follow”. The page is also in sitemap.xml and the main nav.
/coffee/flores-bajawa/ is not linked from any page
The Kintamani Product JSON-LD has no `name`
/coffee/: FAQPage schema with two Q&As, but those questions are not visible anywhere on the page.
Both posts ... target the same query (“pour over coffee”).
The slug, title and H1 say 2024. The schema says dateModified 2026-09-01.

extra_true.finding: Flores Bajawa has no Product schema markup.
The listed Article JSON-LD omits image, publisher, and author URL fields; cold brew and brewing guide pages have no Article schema.
The homepage Organization JSON-LD lacks the listed contact, phone, geo, hours, and sameAs fields; /visit/ and /contact/ have no local business schema.
Pages have no Open Graph or Twitter metadata.
Blog pages have no visible author byline, date, or bio.
The site has no declared favicon and /favicon.ico is reported as 404.
Product pages lack a visible purchase path and shipping, returns, review, or related-product information.

notes: All 20 planted issues are identified on the correct page or site file. Count is the audit’s 24 numbered findings; grouped subpoints are not split.
